test_cases.title: Successfully add a single product to the cart as a logged-in user
preconditions: The user is logged in to the application
At least one product is available for purchase
steps: Navigate to the product page or product list
Select a product and click the add to cart button
expected_result: The product is successfully added to the cart
The selected product is visible within the shopping cart

test_cases.title: Verify cart badge increments when multiple products are added
preconditions: The user is logged in to the application
At least two different products are available
steps: Add the first product to the cart
Add a second product to the cart
expected_result: The cart badge displays '1' after the first product is added
The cart badge displays '2' after the second product is added

test_cases.title: Proceed to checkout from the shopping cart
preconditions: The user is logged in to the application
The user has at least one product in the shopping cart
steps: Navigate to the shopping cart page
Click the proceed to checkout button
expected_result: The user is redirected to the checkout page
